::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 15th [1856]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Caroline Fairclough/12
:::

My dear [Miss Butler](people/person_237.qmd)
I enclose with the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd)’s warm thanks the pay for [Likes & Dislikes](other_books/otherbook_248.qmd).  I am so glad to think of the continuation for I think the notion of setting Emily to tame young ladies running to seed an excellent one.

[Miss Sturges Bourne](people/person_1379.qmd) has just been conducting a sick cousin to Wiesbaden, and thinking with much diversion of Helen. She was near going to Marienbad itself which would have been amusing.  I hope [Lizzie Barnett](people/person_113.qmd) has been gaining all sorts of strength at St Leonards.

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
